newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan offers 80 mln dinar certificates of deposit.
newsitem.headline: Jordan offers 80 mln dinar certificates of deposit.

text.p: Jordan's Central Bank said on Monday it would offer certificates of deposit (CDs) worth 80 million dinars ($113 million) next Saturday.
The bank said it was offering 40 million dinars worth of three-month CDs and another 40 million dinars of six-month CDs.
Average CD yields have fallen to 8.52 pct for three-month paper and 8.75 pct for six-month paper since the bank introduced competitive auctions for the certificates last month.
